title: Controller communications failure
summary: A controller, panel or expander has lost communications with the system.
symptoms: Controller or module offline in the software
Module trouble or comms fault on the keypad

outline.title: Check power to the device
outline.detail: Confirm the module or controller is powered and running.

outline.title: Check the data or network connection
outline.detail: For network devices, check link and addressing. For bus devices, check bus wiring and termination.

outline.title: Check addressing
outline.detail: Duplicate or wrong addresses commonly cause communication faults.

outline.title: Review recent changes
outline.detail: Firmware updates, network changes or new modules often come before comms faults.

verification.notes: Demonstration workflow outline. General fault-finding order only — follow the manufacturer's documentation and site procedures.
